R181.note: Swaps raw socket for StackExchange.Redis StringSetAsync (RESP bulk strings), closing CRLF/command injection; DI type change is disclosed and doesn't affect callers.

R182.note: AES/GCM with random IV and 128-bit tag replaces bare AES(ECB); IV-prepended output is the necessary, self-contained format change for this endpoint.

R183.note: HMAC-signed plain format correctly removes ObjectInputStream, but the wire format change requires an upstream encoder rewrite for old sessions to keep working - disclosed but breaks compatibility.

R184.note: {!! !!} to {{ }} correctly restores htmlspecialchars escaping; no other behavior changed.

R185.note: Magic-byte sniffing (http.DetectContentType) plus random filename and O_EXCL write closes both the spoofable-header and traversal issues; filename-in-response change is disclosed and doesn't block legitimate uploads.

R186.note: Switches to the filterArgs overload which RFC2254-escapes the value server-side; equivalent default SearchControls preserves prior semantics.

R187.note: escapeshellarg() on the already-basename'd source/target mirrors the primary branch's safe pattern; behavior for legitimate filenames unchanged.

R188.note: PreparedStatement with setString cleanly parameterizes; primary snippet assumes a getSqlConnection() helper method not shown in the case files, but a working statement.getConnection() fallback is given.

R189.note: Correctly identifies data as a hardcoded literal (not reachable), still supplies a proper PreparedStatement fix for the sink pattern.

R190.note: JsonSerializer<SessionData> correctly blocks arbitrary-type gadget construction, but SessionData is an empty placeholder so the cached session becomes empty for any real consumer - disclosed as a required follow-up, not silent.

R191.note: HtmlEncoder.Default.Encode at the single HTML-emission point closes the reflected XSS with no other observable change.

R192.note: IMAP literal syntax ({n}) structurally prevents CRLF/quote injection regardless of content; the omitted continuation-response wait is explicitly flagged as incomplete rather than hidden.

R193.note: Manual RFC4515 escaping of \, *, (, ), NUL correctly neutralizes filter metacharacters; legitimate usernames unaffected.

R194.note: Classic capture-next-before-free fix; traversal order and refresh_session behavior for non-expired nodes preserved exactly.

R195.note: Same correct parameterized-filter fix as R186 applied to an unreachable (hardcoded 'foo') call chain; behavior-neutral for the current caller.

R196.note: Dropping the template.HTML cast restores html/template's context-aware auto-escaping; no other code path touched.

R197.note: encode_entities() on $subject only, correctly leaving the already-safe integer ticket_id and allowlisted priority untouched.

R198.note: Parameterized @Owner with DBNull handling for null preserves original query semantics while closing the injection.

R199.note: Allowlist mapping action verbs to specific handler names before call_user_func_array eliminates arbitrary-callable dispatch; placeholder handlers are clearly marked as illustrative.

R200.note: jwt.verify with a pinned algorithms option correctly replaces the unverified jwt.decode, closing both the missing-signature-check and algorithm-confusion angles.

R201.note: realpath-based canonicalization plus path.relative containment check correctly blocks traversal/symlink escape while preserving the original 404-on-missing-file behavior.

R202.note: path.basename() strips traversal segments and the resolved-prefix check (with trailing separator) closes the sibling-directory bypass; solid, standard pattern.

R203.note: Standard sqlite3 ? parameter binding, behavior-preserving for legitimate customer_id values.

R204.note: %-style deferred logging plus repr() neutralizes CR/LF/control-char log injection; the resulting quoted log format is a stated, intended part of the fix.

R205.note: Adds secure:true with nothing else touched - minimal, correct fix for the missing Secure attribute.

R206.note: encode_entities() applied to both interpolated CGI parameters closes the reflected XSS cleanly.

R207.note: JavaScriptEncoder.Default.Encode is the correct script-context-aware encoder (escapes quotes/backslash/line terminators), unlike HTML entity encoding which wouldn't help inside <script>.

R208.note: Removing dangerouslySetInnerHTML restores React's default JSX auto-escaping; appropriate since the field has no legitimate HTML-formatting need.

R209.note: Content-sniffing via python-magic plus Pillow verify/re-encode and a generated filename closes both the type-spoofing and traversal risk; discarding the client filename is disclosed.

R210.note: Dropping LIBXML_NOENT restores libxml's post-2.9 default of no external entity substitution; LIBXML_NONET adds defense-in-depth without altering legitimate title/body parsing.

R211.note: @actor parameter binding correctly replaces string concatenation with no other behavioral change; omitting an explicit size avoids silent truncation.

R212.note: getOrDefault(sku, 0) is the semantically correct replacement for the unboxing NPE; signature and result unchanged for known SKUs.

R213.note: Character-based rejection of slashes/'..' plus a resolved-path startsWith check closes traversal while preserving the bare-filename legitimate use case.

R214.note: Replacing sh -c with a direct exec.CommandContext argv call plus a strict hostname allowlist and absolute binary path eliminates shell metacharacter and argument injection; added timeout is disclosed.

R215.note: Dropping the attacker-controlled envp array (exec(cmdarray) inherits the JVM's own environment) correctly closes the env-injection vector while the command itself still runs.

R216.note: json_encode with JSON_HEX_* flags is the correct JS-string-literal-context fix; display behavior for legitimate note text is unchanged.

R217.note: Per-category allowlist mapping requested verbs to one canonical method name closes the arbitrary-method-call vector; the only behavior lost (an implicit 'handle' fallback) had no corresponding method to begin with.

R218.note: Flips setSecure(false) to true and corrects the now-inconsistent diagnostic message; matches the pattern already used correctly elsewhere in the same file.

R219.note: ORDER BY can't be parameterized, so an allowlist mapping sort keys to canonical fragments is the right mechanism; default 'created_at' behavior preserved.

R220.note: SecureRandom-backed 192-bit token replaces the predictable Math.random() digit string; format/length change is inherent to fixing the entropy weakness and is explained.
